## 1.03 CREDITSARISINGFROMSUBSTITUTIONS

1. Credits arising from accepted substitutions will be credited to the Contract in such sums as maybe agreed upon between the Employer and the Contractor after being assessed by Contract Administrator and the Contract Price will be adjusted accordingly. No substitutions will be permitted without the prior written acceptance of Contract Administrator.

## 1.04 MECHANICAL. ELECTRICAL SPECIFIED AND ACCEPTABLE MANUFACTURERS

1. If materials or equipment manufactured dand/or suppliedisby a manufacturer not specified, ensure that the substituted material or equipment is equivalent in performance and operating characteristics to the specified product and payfor any and all additional costs for the associated substitution.Inaddition，in mechanicaland electricalrooms where apparatus named as acceptable is used in lieu of the specified product, and the dimensions differ from the specified product, prepare and submit for approval,\_ accurately dimensioned layout of rooms affected.All costs resulting from Contractor's substitutions shall be borne by the Contractor.
2. Within thirty (30) days of the Commencement Date, prepare and submit to Contract Administrator, a list of all mechanical and electrical equipment to be supplied.  List manufacturers in their respective categories, "As Specified", or"Acceptable"or"Alternative"".

## 1.05 REIMBUFSEMENTOFSUPERVISIONCONSULTANT'SCOSTS

1. In the event substitutions are proposed to the Supervision Consultant after the Contract has been awarded, the Supervision Consultant will record all time used byt the SupervisionConsultant and its subSupervision Consultants in evaluating each such proposed substitution.
2. If the Supervision Consultant does not consider the proposed substitution acceptable, the Contractor promptly upon receipt of the Supervision Consultant's billing shall reimburse the Supervision Consultant at direct cost to the Supervision Consultant and its subSupervision Consultants for all time spent by them in evaluating the proposed substitution to be "or equal".

## 1.06 DELAYS
